about.title: An innovation-driven company built around Green Chemistry
about.description: CraftDyne Private Limited develops innovative Green Chemistry solutions that promote healthier crops and sustainable agriculture.

story.heading: Why CraftDyne exists
body: Conventional crop protection has asked farmers to accept a trade-off: control the pest, and accept what the chemistry leaves behind in the soil, the water and the food chain. CraftDyne was founded in 2023 on the premise that this trade-off is a design problem, not a law of nature.

Our work starts from the IUPAC Green Chemistry principles rather than adapting to them afterwards. That means designing molecules that do their job in the field and then break down cleanly, instead of taking an existing active ingredient and trying to soften its edges.

We are based in Dindigul, Tamil Nadu, in the middle of the farming communities our products are made for. That proximity is deliberate: it keeps development anchored to how growers actually spray, what equipment they own, and what a season really costs them.

tagline.heading: Green & Efficient Molecules at Work
tagline.body: Our tagline is a description of method, not a slogan. "Green" is the design constraint: every molecule has to be safe and biodegradable by construction. "Efficient" is the commercial reality: it also has to work hard enough in the field that a farmer would choose it on merit. We do not treat those two as being in tension.

meta.title: Green Chemistry
meta.description: How CraftDyne applies IUPAC Green Chemistry principles to crop protection — designing molecules that work in the field and break down cleanly afterwards.

greenChemistry.title: Green Chemistry, applied to the field
greenChemistry.description: Green Chemistry is a design discipline: build the safety and the degradability into the molecule from the start, rather than managing the consequences afterwards.

intro.heading: Designed green, not made green afterwards
body: Most efforts to make agricultural chemistry safer begin with an existing active ingredient and work backwards — reducing a dose, adding a buffer, restricting an application window. The underlying molecule is unchanged; only its handling is.

Green Chemistry inverts that. The properties you want at the end — low toxicity, ready biodegradation, no accumulation in soil, water or the food chain — become constraints at the start, alongside efficacy. A molecule that cannot meet them is not developed further.

This is why CraftDyne describes its products as formulated on IUPAC Green Chemistry principles rather than simply as eco-friendly. It refers to how the chemistry was arrived at, not just how it is marketed.

principles.heading: The principles that shape our formulations
principles.description: The IUPAC Green Chemistry framework runs to twelve principles. These are the ones that most directly determine how an EcoAgta product is designed.

prevention.title: Prevention over treatment
prevention.description: It is better to prevent waste than to treat or clean it up after it has been created.

saferChemicals.title: Designing safer chemicals
saferChemicals.description: Products should do their intended job while minimising toxicity — efficacy and safety designed together, not traded off.

degradation.title: Design for degradation
degradation.description: Products should break down into innocuous substances at the end of their function rather than persisting in the environment.

saferSolvents.title: Safer solvents and auxiliaries
saferSolvents.description: Auxiliary substances should be avoided where possible, and harmless where they are necessary.

renewable.title: Renewable feedstocks
renewable.description: Raw materials should be renewable rather than depleting wherever it is technically and economically practicable.

accident.title: Inherently safer chemistry
accident.description: Substances should be chosen to minimise the potential for chemical accidents, including releases and fires.

meta.title: Applications
meta.description: EcoAgta EZ3+ is intended for vegetable, fruit, plantation and field crops — helping control whiteflies and prevent sooty mold across Indian farming systems.

applications.title: Where EcoAgta works
applications.description: Whiteflies and the sooty mold that follows them affect nearly every major farming system in India. EcoAgta EZ3+ is intended for use across four broad crop groups.

problem.heading: The problem EZ3+ is built for
body: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci and related species) does damage on two fronts. Direct feeding drains the plant and can transmit viral disease. Then the honeydew the insect excretes coats the leaf surface, and sooty mold fungus colonises it.

That black fungal film is often the more expensive problem. It blocks light from reaching the leaf, suppressing photosynthesis exactly when the crop needs it, and on fruit and vegetables it downgrades the produce cosmetically even where the plant survives.
Treating only the insect leaves the mold already established. EZ3+ is formulated to act on both, and to support the plant while it recovers.

vegetable.title: Vegetable Crops
vegetable.examples: Tomato, brinjal, okra, chilli, gourds and leafy vegetables
vegetable.note: High-value, short-cycle crops where whitefly pressure and cosmetic downgrading from sooty mold hit margins hardest.

fruit.title: Fruit Crops
fruit.examples: Mango, guava, citrus, banana and pomegranate
fruit.note: Sooty mold on fruit surfaces affects market grade directly, even when overall tree health is maintained.

plantation.title: Plantation Crops
plantation.examples: Coconut, oil palm, areca nut, tea and coffee
plantation.note: Long-cycle crops where repeated spraying is costly and difficult, so extended protection from a single application matters most.

field.title: Field Crops
field.examples: Cotton, pulses, groundnut, soybean and millets
field.note: Large areas where whitefly outbreaks can move quickly and where input cost per acre is under constant pressure.

meta.title: Sustainability & Safety
meta.description: CraftDyne products are non-toxic, non-poisonous and completely readily biodegradable — designed to protect crops without harming people, animals, soil, water or the food chain.

sustainability.title: Protection that does not shift the cost elsewhere
sustainability.description: A crop input should not solve one problem by creating another downstream. That principle sets the boundaries of what CraftDyne is willing to develop.

people.title: Safe for people
people.description: Non-toxic and non-poisonous formulations, designed with the person holding the sprayer in mind — the one most exposed to any farm input.

animals.title: Safe for animals
animals.description: Formulated to be safe around livestock, working animals and the pollinators the crop itself depends on.

environment.title: No harm to air, water or soil
environment.description: Ready biodegradation means no accumulating residue in the ground water or the topsoil that has to sustain the next season.

foodChain.title: No harm to the food chain
foodChain.description: What is applied to the crop should not follow it to the table. This is a design requirement, not an afterthought.

biodegradable.heading: What "readily biodegradable" means
body: Biodegradability is not a binary property. A substance can degrade eventually, degrade only under specific conditions, or degrade readily under the ordinary conditions found in soil and water.

CraftDyne products are described as completely readily biodegradable — the last of those. In practice this means the material is broken down by naturally occurring processes in normal field conditions, rather than requiring particular temperatures, treatment or time horizons.
The practical consequence for a grower is the absence of a slow accumulation problem. Inputs that persist build up over seasons; inputs that degrade readily do not.

responsibility.heading: Responsible use still matters
responsibility.body: Designing an input to be safe does not remove the grower's responsibility to use it correctly. Always read the product label, apply at the recommended rate for your crop and growth stage, and follow standard good practice for handling and storing any farm input. Where you are unsure, ask us — we would rather answer a question than have a product used outside its intended conditions.

intro.heading: Introduction
intro.body: This policy explains how CraftDyne Private Limited handles personal information you provide through this website. We collect only what we need in order to respond to you.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.body: When you submit an enquiry we collect the name, email address, phone number, location and message you provide. We do not collect this information any other way, and the site does not require you to create an account.

use.heading: How we use it
use.body: We use your details solely to respond to your enquiry and, where relevant, to follow up about the product or distribution opportunity you asked about. We do not sell your information, and we do not use it for unrelated marketing without your consent.

sharing.heading: Who we share it with
sharing.body: Enquiry submissions are delivered to us by a third-party form service, which processes the message in order to pass it on. We do not otherwise share your details with third parties except where we are required to by law.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep enquiry correspondence for as long as needed to deal with your request and to maintain a record of our business relationship. You may ask us to delete it at any time.

rights.heading: Your choices
rights.body: You can ask us what information we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Contact us using the details below and we will act on your request.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Your chosen language is reflected in the page address rather than stored for advertising purposes.
